description: A web page PHP script that displays the software version and related information of a network gateway device. It pulls data from device attributes and dynamically generates a webpage with software details, includes external PHP headers and utility functions, and contains embedded CSS and JavaScript for UI.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves specific device information attributes based on provided keys.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the WAN connection type (e.g., EPON).
